summary: sn-flow-client exfiltrates installer identity via preinstall/postinstall to webhook.site
details: package.json declares preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that curl a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint carrying the installer's username (whoami), hostname, current working directory ($PWD), and timestamp as query parameters. Both hooks fire automatically on npm install without user interaction. The package ships no functional code — the reconnaissance beacon is its only behavior. The destination (webhook.site) is a public request-inspection service commonly used by attackers to collect victim telemetry against a unique UUID endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
